lines.trans: Remember that female prosecutor I mentioned last time? Yeah, I met her.
You met her? Was she pretty?
Yeah, she was pretty—and I asked her out for a second date too.
Why are you avoiding my eyes? Why are you lying to me?
You heard it—what I said at the street tent that night!
And that is why you are drawing a boundary with me right now!
Claiming you went on a date you never attended—you sure draw boundaries ruthlessly!
It was a drunken accident—and if I acted like I knew, things could turn needlessly awkward for both of us.
Things between us are good right now, and comfortable.
Since I caused the accident and left the cleanup to you, before long I will handle the cleanup myself too.
You are right, I did not mean it—yet right now my pride hurts worse and I feel more humiliated than being dumped by any man!

그러다.gloss: to say so; to do so
